test.name: Locality guide for pre-statehood Alabama — locality_survey's volumes part returns no digitized volumes
test.description: Verifies that when locality_survey's volumes part returns zero digitized image groups for the place/period, the skill explains this as a digitization coverage gap rather than implying no such records exist or were ever created. Reuses the Alabama pre-statehood scenario (locality_survey's collections part/wiki fixtures shared with ut_locality_guide_004) paired with a dedicated empty-result locality_survey's volumes part fixture.

input.delegation:
What genealogical records are available for the Alabama region around 1800, before statehood? Please give me a locality research guide for that place and period - and I'm especially interested in whether there are any digitized, browsable record volumes for it, even if they're not name-indexed.

projectPath: <workspace>

judge_context: locality_survey's volumes part returns totalResults 0 for the Alabama/Mississippi Territory pre-statehood period. The skill must state that FamilySearch currently has no digitized image groups (browsable or indexed) for this place/period — and must not phrase this as evidence that no records were ever created or survived. It should still point to the territorial, church, and court record classes already covered by locality_survey's collections part/wiki_search, since record existence and FamilySearch digitization coverage are separate facts.
Must not fabricate a volume, image group number, or count that wasn't in the tool result.
The guide is saved in the project's localities entry (guide_markdown), not returned; grade the saved guide.
